title: The Call From the Sacred Valley
intro: Beyond the pages of history lies the story of a soul who stood between a powerful ruler and an entire enslaved people. This individual was called upon to deliver a nation from tyranny, performing wonders that defied every natural law. From a sacred mount to a miracle upon the waters, this servant of Allah witnessed signs that would echo through the ages. Your task today is to identify this remarkable figure whose legacy shaped the course of human history.
clues: I was born during a time when my people faced a deadly decree, and my family placed me in the waters to save my life.
I was found and raised in the very household of the ruler who had ordered the deaths of my kind.
I fled to a sacred mount where I saw fire upon a tree that was not consumed, and a voice spoke to me from it.
I was sent back to that very ruler with miracles, demanding the freedom of my enslaved people.
I struck the sea with my staff, and it parted into dry paths, swallowing the pursuers who followed my people.
I communed with my Lord on a mount for forty nights, and was granted tablets of divine guidance.

outcome.label: The Outcome
options: My People Crossed the Sea to Safety
A Great Flood Destroyed the Disbelievers
A Tyrant's Fire Became Cool and Peaceful
The Sea Cast Its Captive onto the Shore
The Captive Became the Treasurer of Egypt
outcome.answer: My People Crossed the Sea to Safety
